description: "Godolphin, Complete" by Baron Edward Bulwer Lytton Lytton is a satirical romance novel published in 1834. The story follows idealistic Percy Godolphin and the intelligent, ambitious Constance Vernon as they navigate the world of early 19th-century British high society.
